name: What types of glass are available for patio door replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of glass are available for patio door replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: For patio doors, common glass options include tempered glass for safety, as it shatters into small, less harmful pieces. Insulated glass units (IGUs) are standard, offering energy efficiency with two or more panes separated by a gas-filled space. You can also choose Low-E (low-emissivity) coatings to further enhance thermal performance by reducing heat transfer. Other options include tinted glass for privacy or UV protection, and laminated glass for enhanced security.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common options include tempered glass for safety, insulated glass units (IGUs) for energy efficiency, and Low-E coatings to reduce heat transfer. Tinted and laminated glass are also available.
